_readme: Retrieval evaluation set. Each case names a question and the passage that
must come back for an answer to be possible at all — identified by a phrase
the corpus actually contains, verified against data/all_chunks.json rather
than assumed. A case fails when no retrieved passage carries that phrase,
which means the model could not have answered correctly however good it is.
expect_text is matched case-insensitively against the retrieved passage.
expect: refusal means nothing should clear the distance floor.
